visual_review.method: Native front demo frames at 0, 8, 16, 23, 33, 44, 56, 69 and 79.8 seconds, rear final photograph; native front Dream frames every 10 seconds from 0 to 80; frozen-source trace rescoring.
visual_review.demo: Both arms fold the four prepared paper flaps and secure the two overlaps with separate tape strips. Final front and rear views show the blue paper covering the box; both arms are clear for 9.5 seconds. Score 1.0.
visual_review.dream: Moves a flap but does not secure either pair. Completes the 1,600-action budget at 0.0.
visual_review.limitations: Pre-cut paper has passive creases and fixed central support; no arbitrary crumpling. Tape capture and adhesion are simplified. The demo's closed-side render offset is absent from the earlier baseline source, but exact code comparison and all-frame angle checks prove that branch never activates in the baseline. Physics and observations are unchanged.
